hotel_1star_proxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Berlin? Hotel Prices for Berlin, Germany | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_proxy.evidenceText: Search snippet for the exact Berlin hotel page reports: 'The average price of the 109 terrific 1-star hotels in Berlin is $139, and the median price is $115.' It identifies the 1-star section as the average price for one night and the page states that hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes.
hotel_1star_proxy.taxEvidence: The same search snippet states: '(All hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes, and come from a base price that is reported by Kayak.)' The star-rating summary also says prices are before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_proxy.referencePeriod: Search result crawled 3 weeks ago; search-snippet evidence only, no page read.

hotel_1star_proxy.reason: Labelled source-level proxy candidate only: exact-city one-star USD one-night statistic and tax basis in the first snippet, paired with same-source exact-city double-occupancy wording in the second snippet.
